title: Permissionless first-claimer captures the entire accumulated discount in one shot; minRewardTokenSupplied defaults to 0 (intended incentive + residual MEV note)
rootCauseClass: MEV / first-claimer capture / default-disabled slippage guard (by-design)
description: claim() skims ALL non-exempt strategies' surplus and applies the discount to the whole sum in a single permissionless call (L497). Accumulated yield is a growing pot; the first valid-NFT caller captures the full discount on it. This IS the designed decentralized-conversion incentive (registry designDecisions[0]: 'Discount rate incentivizes external claimers to pay gas costs for conversion'). PATTERN-007's nudge winner-take-all signature is a RED HERRING: nudge pays a PROPORTIONAL share to an OWNER-set recipient (L512). The only in-scope residual worth surfacing is the minRewardTokenSupplied=0 default, which disables the per-claim floor.
impact: None beyond the budgeted incentive. The protocol pays exactly discount*yield regardless of WHO claims, so there is no protocol value leak. Losers of the claim race revert with ZeroAmount (NFT preserved, gas wasted) — ordinary MEV friction. A careless/bot claimer passing min=0 accepts any amount, including the dust/zero-payment edge (cross-ref L-01), harming only their own economics.
attackPath: 1. Accumulated yield is a growing pot; a searcher backruns a large surplus accrual / a paused-token unpause.
2. The searcher wins the claim with a higher gas bid and captures the full discount on the pot in one shot.

3. Losers of the race revert with ZeroAmount (NFT preserved, gas wasted) — ordinary MEV friction. There is no shared post-loop balance to skim (the first claim empties the pot), so no sandwich exists.

4. Residual note: minRewardTokenSupplied defaults to 0, disabling the per-claim floor — a careless/bot claimer accepting any amount can hit the dust/zero-payment edge (cross-ref L-01), harming only their own economics.
recommendation: None required for security. Optionally document the MEV/race expectation for integrators and recommend claim bots always pass a non-zero minRewardTokenSupplied derived from calculateClaimAmount (with a buffer) to avoid the dust/zero-payment edge.
verification: Economic reasoning. No exploit (explicitly down-weighted from the pattern's potential-medium; no sandwich exists — the first claim empties the pot, there is no shared post-loop balance to skim). Kept visible per Law 1 rather than silently dropped as by-design.

poc.note: QA / by-design incentive; no exploit path. Verified by economic reasoning.
